title: Signal or Noise? Evaluating Large Language Models in Resume Screening Across Contextual Variations and Human Expert Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM resume evaluation scores across different prompt conditions containing varied organizational contexts (multinational corporation vs. startup) and baseline scenarios to measure the models' sensitivity to prompt variations.

Using Signal Detection Theory frameworks to measure the models' systematic tendency to respond positively or negatively (e.g., score inflation) when evaluating resumes under conditions of information scarcity or reduced job description context.
